verdict.rationale: ReelMimic's core workflow is delegation to in-product AI agents. You tell it what to make, refine the plan in an in-app chat (screenshots accepted), and up to 6 agents build the video with cross-agent review. Their reasoning, commands and logs are visible in the product. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is the project's own README), and a self-contained assistant, since the agents run on the user's own Claude Code or Codex.
